messages.content: What is the equivalent of $20 in British Pounds?

function.name: weather_in_location
function.description: Retrieve the current weather conditions for a specified location, including temperature, humidity, and general conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current USD‑GBP exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent market data (mid‑2026), the rate is roughly:

| Currency | Rate (approx.) |
|----------|----------------|
| 1 USD    | 0.78 GBP       |

Using that rate:

\[
20\ \text{USD} \times 0.78\ \frac{\text{GBP}}{\text{USD}} \approx 15.6\ \text{GBP}
\]

So **$20 is about £15.60**.

> **Important:** Exchange rates change constantly. For an exact, up‑to‑date conversion, check a reliable financial news source, a bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion tool such as XE.com, OANDA, or your banking app. If you’re planning a transaction, it’s a good idea to confirm the rate at the time of the transfer.
